name: 25th Avenue Farmers' Market

description: 25th Avenue Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 194 W. 25th Ave., CA. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
